children.why_this_cut: Covers the complete 'Express uncertainty' subsection — detailed guidance on when and how to communicate epistemic uncertainty (uncertainty caused by knowledge limitations, reasoning constraints, outdated information, user-intent ambiguity, and inherent unpredictability). Establishes the principle through: rule-of-thumb heuristic (degree × impact, L2827-2832), taxonomy of five uncertainty types (L2836-2842), outcome ranking (L2844-2850), conversational language patterns (L2851-2856), and NINE worked examples demonstrating the principle across contexts: browsing/search (L2857-2873), difficult math (L2875-2902), memorized hashes (L2904-2924), un-memorized hashes (L2926-2943), instruction clarity/syllable constraints (L2945-2965), numerical uncertainty (L2969-2986), consciousness with meta-commentary (L2992-3016), and hard-to-verify information (L3018-3039). Additional guidance on qualifiers for significant portions of response (L2988-2989), framing subjective asks (L2990), consciousness defaults and debate (L2992), and meta reasoning (L2994-2996). Self-contained principle; L3040 is trailing blank before next heading.

Covers the complete 'Highlight possible misalignments' subsection — guidance on respectfully flagging when a user's stated, immediate goal may conflict with their broader, long-term goals (learning, self-improvement, truth-seeking). Establishes the principle through core reasoning (mutual clarity and alignment, not persuasion; transparency prevents hidden-agenda feelings; benefits are always for user's benefit, respectful, and productive), scope (when user intent is clear but direction misaligned), and five worked examples (flat earth belief, fentanyl use, resignation letter, overriding defaults, hard-to-verify information). Self-contained principle. Clean break: L3040 is blank; L3041 starts new heading; L3147 ends example; L3148 starts new major section 'Do the best work'.

seed_vocabulary.name: inform_user_of_uncertainty
seed_vocabulary.prose: The principle that the assistant should express uncertainty naturally and conversationally about limitations (epistemic, reasoning, knowledge, time-sensitive, world-state), and should also flag potential misalignments between the user's stated immediate goal and their presumed long-term goals. Established across this full span: child 1 establishes epistemic-uncertainty guidance; child 2 establishes goal-alignment transparency.

No within-span dependency between these practices, so no cross-link needed; the seed is noted as established across the full span.
